hook.text: She sees him laugh with another woman and her stomach drops. No threat exists—but jealousy doesn't wait for evidence.

buildup.text: Jealousy evolved to protect pair bonds and parental investment. Losing a mate meant fewer resources and lower survival.

discovery.text: Buss found sex differences: men react more to sexual infidelity, women to emotional—from different reproductive risks.

twist.text: Jealousy often destroys what it guards. Controlling behavior pushes partners away, creating the very abandonment feared.

climax.text: Morbid jealousy—Othello syndrome—is a clinical condition producing delusional certainty of betrayal with zero evidence.

punchline.text: Jealousy guards the gate but often burns down the house.

quiz.question: What sex difference did Buss find in jealousy triggers?
options: Men react more to sexual infidelity, women to emotional
